Bundled third-party software: MediaPipe Face Mesh (JavaScript solution, npm package @mediapipe/face_mesh 0.4.1633559619)
Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE in this folder).
The face_mesh_solution_packed_assets.data file contains the BlazeFace (short range) face detector and the FaceMesh V2 landmark model;
their model cards state the same licence (Apache License, Version 2.0):
  https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/MediaPipe%20BlazeFace%20Model%20Card%20(Short%20Range).pdf
  https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20MediaPipe%20Face%20Mesh%20V2.pdf
The files are used unmodified. Face analysis runs entirely in the browser; images are never uploaded.


Bundled third-party software (second engine): MediaPipe Tasks Vision (npm package @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.1.1), runtime only, used unmodified.
Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (package.json of the tarball states Apache-2.0; the licence text is in vendor/mediapipe/tasks-vision/LICENSE).

The model file (face_landmarker.task) is NOT bundled. Install it with tools/fetch-face-landmarker.mjs; its licence must be confirmed from Google's model card (not read in this build).
Face analysis runs entirely in the browser; images are never uploaded. See docs/FACE_ENGINES.md for what is verified and what is not.
